headline: US AI safety centre staff told to report to the White House
body: AP reported that staff at CAISSI, the US AI safety centre, were told to informally report to the White House, raising questions about its independence and pulling Alignment & Control down 0.28. Nvidia reportedly ordered cloud partners to keep 51% of capacity for non-Chinese clients, trimming Capability Velocity, and Jensen Huang admitted an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, prompting a board probe and a small rise in Catastrophic Risk. President Trump told 60 Minutes he is open to AI guardrails while framing AI as a race with China, lifting Global Coordination. Meta expanded AI age detection worldwide, raising Surveillance & Control. Protector God and Enslaved God fell; 1984 rose. Horizon Balance fell to -18.87 from -18.51.
movers_note: Protector God -0.34, led by the CAISSI report (-0.17). Enslaved God -0.25, from the CAISSI report (-0.12) and Nvidia's capacity order (-0.09). 1984 +0.25, from Meta's age detection (+0.13) and Trump's guardrails remarks (+0.10).
coming_up: House briefing request to Jensen Huang, 18 Nov
